title: Love spoon
summary: Whittle a love spoon from a block of sycamore: a bowl, a long handle with chain links and a heart at the top.
howToPlay: The lit piece in its frame shows what to make.
Drag across the block to take cells away; two chisels, fine and broad.
Press Check when the shape is right.
rules: Removing a cell inside the shape costs as much as leaving one outside it.
Three stars for 88 or more, two stars for 65 and one star for 40.
Watch and learn carves and waxes a whole round for you.
heritageNote: Welsh woodcarvers have carved decorated spoons from a single piece of wood for centuries. Chain links, a ball in a cage and hearts were cut with a small knife, each with a meaning chosen by the carver.
